title: DeepMind RSA - 1600x Signature Forgery Warning
content:
Google DeepMind ne roughly 6 Nov 2026 ko
research share kiya.
Human-guided AI agents ne LEGACY 1024-BIT
RSA mein 2 weaknesses find kiye.
Pushmeet Kohli VP Science ke saath,
researchers Dj Dvijotham, Abhradeep
Thakurta, Nadia Heninger aur Emmanuel
Thomé.
Headline number: short 32-byte
fingerprints pe signature forgery
algorithm roughly 1,600 TIMES more
efficient — DeepMind ka theoretical
estimate.
End tak raho. Panic mat karo. Modern
RSA-2048 pe asar nahi. Inventory aur
rotate ka how-to dunga.

Pehle clear boundary.
Yeh results LEGACY 1024-bit RSA pe apply
hote hain, modern schemes pe nahi.
Kohli ke hisaab se results do not affect
modern schemes such as RSA 2048.
RSA-1024 already retired / unsafe consider
hota hai — isi liye researchers sandbox
mein use karte hain.
Matlab: agar tumhare production certs 2048
ya upar hain, yeh specific break tumhara
live key break nahi kar raha.
Lekin tempo badal gaya: AI agents
cryptanalysis ko human-team speed se far
faster probe kar sakte hain.

Pehli weakness: digital signatures aur padding.
Padding message ko fixed-size block banata
hai. Protection depend karti hai attacker
kitna block control karta hai.
Jab attacker roughly half block ya zyada
control kare, padding meaningful
protection add nahi karti — forgery nearly
as easy as no padding.
Sandbox reproduction mein agents ne
already-solved 1024-bit benchmark key pe
result reproduce kiya: 3.5 TIMES LESS CPU
time, aur under a thousandth of the
compute jo underlying key break karne mein
lage.
Tougher case — short 32-byte digital
fingerprint — pe naya algorithm: DeepMind
theoretical estimate se prior best se
roughly 1,600 times more efficient for
1024-bit keys.

Doosri weakness: kai RSA keys same bit
length pe ek saath factor karna.
Shared standard size ki wajah se attacker
ek large upfront computation spread kar
sakta hai, average cost per key girati
hai.
DeepMind agents ne naya batch method
discover kiya — better asymptotic
complexity than previously known.
Average cost of factoring each additional
1024-bit key about 30 TIMES LOWER.
Yeh batch economics defenders ke liye
important hai: inventory mein agar kai
legacy 1024 keys bache hain, risk surface
multiply hota hai.

Practical how-to for defenders —
authorized inventory only.
Step 1: inventory. Certs, keys, APIs,
vendor integrations — kahan abhi bhi
RSA-1024 dikhta hai.
TLS endpoints, JWT signing, S/MIME,
internal PKI, old IoT firmware,
third-party webhooks.
Step 2: rotate. 1024 milta hai to 2048 ya
stronger pe migrate karo. Prefer modern
curves where your stack allows, but at
minimum leave 1024.
Step 3: treat AI as tempo. Hardness
margins ab slowly-eroding assumption nahi.
Agents search space ko compress karte
hain.
Maan lo tumhari company ke paas 2012 ka
internal CA abhi bhi 1024 intermediate use
karti hai — pehle usko list karo, phir
rotate window set karo, phir monitor.
Hypothetical hai — measure kiye bina claim nahi.

Mera take simple hai.
Biggest AI move of the month?
Cryptanalysis tempo ke liye haan — kyunki
1,600x aur 30x numbers legacy sandbox pe
hain, lekin signal clear hai.
Fear reel mat banao. Inventory reel banao.
Legacy 1024 find karo. Rotate karo. Modern
2048+ pe stay karo. Agent-assisted
research ko defender toolkit samjho,
attack toy nahi.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
